meta.name: deepspot-m
meta.description: Generate transcriptome-wide virtual spatial transcriptomics from H&E histology with DeepSpot-M. Use when you need spatial gene expression in log1p-CPM for 224x224 tiles at about 20x, want to query protein-coding genes by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or want to run prediction across a whole slide after tiling with histolab.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 H&E 病理切片图像转成可查询的空间基因表达数据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有 H&E 切片图像,想不测序就得到空间基因表达。
copy.tagline_en: Turn H&E histology slides into queryable spatial gene expression data
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have H&E slides and want spatial gene expression without sequencing

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把 224x224、约 20x 的 H&E 小图输入 DeepSpot-M,按基因符号查询约 1.9 万个蛋白编码基因,输出 log1p-CPM 的空间表达值,并按 tile 网格排布。
howto.when: 当你需要 224x224、约 20x 切片的 log1p-CPM 空间基因表达,或想按基因符号查询蛋白编码基因,或用 histolab 分块后跑整张切片时。

say.text: 用 DeepSpot-M 预测这张 H&E 小图的 EPCAM、CD3D 表达
say.note: 返回 log1p-CPM,列顺序与传入基因列表一致

say.text: 换 source=prott5,重新预测同一批 tile
say.note: 五种嵌入来源各给出不同结果

say.text: 把整张切片的 tile 批量预测,拼成 AnnData
say.note: 输出按 tile-ID 对齐坐标

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can feed 224x224, ~20x H&E tiles to DeepSpot-M, query ~19k protein-coding genes by symbol, and return spatial expression in log1p-CPM laid out on the tile grid.
howto.when_en: Use it for log1p-CPM spatial expression on 224x224 ~20x tiles, gene queries by symbol instead of a fixed panel, or slide-wide prediction after histolab tiling.

say_en.text: Predict EPCAM and CD3D for this H&E tile with DeepSpot-M
say_en.note: Returns log1p-CPM aligned to your gene list

say_en.text: Re-run the same tiles with source='prott5'
say_en.note: Each embedding source gives a different view

say_en.text: Batch-predict a whole slide's tiles and assemble AnnData
